en.quote: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak unto him: and if he stand to it, and say, I like not to take her;
en.riddle: I like not to take her
en.speaker: brother

he.quote: וְקָֽרְאוּ־לוֹ זִקְנֵי־עִירוֹ וְדִבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וְעָמַד וְאָמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי לְקַחְתָּֽהּ
he.speaker: אִישׁ
